in_sanskrit.name: वौघव्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Falgun is derived from the Sanskrit word 'वौघव्' (Vaughava). It is a compound word, where 'वाउ' (Vau) means 'bright, radiant, glowing' and 'घव' (Ghava) means 'wind'. The name is often associated with the bright, glowing sun and the arrival of spring. It is the name of the Hindu month Falgun, which falls in February or March, marking the beginning of spring.

in_hindi.name: फाल्गुन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Falgun in Hindi is फाल्गुन (Phalguna). The meaning of the name is 'शितल' (Shital), which means 'cool, calm, peaceful'. However, it is also associated with the Hindu month of the same name, which is associated with the arrival of spring and the bright, glowing sun.

in_tamil.name: பால்குனம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name for Falgun is பால்குனம் (Palgunam). The meaning of the name is 'போர்' (Por), which means 'bright, shining, radiant'. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'वौघव्' (Vaughava) and has the same meaning as the Sanskrit and Hindi names.

in_telugu.name: ఫాల్గున
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name for Falgun is ఫాల్గున (Phalguna). The meaning of the name is 'శిటల' (Shitala), which means 'cool, calm, peaceful'. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'वौघव्' (Vaughava) and has the same meaning as the Sanskrit, Hindi, and Tamil names.
